title: Package B: canonical records, generated views and checks

approval.evidence: Approve PLAN-002 only, including its listed tests and documentation

scope: Canonical JSON records for decisions, packages and releases
npm run records: DECISIONS.md, CHANGELOG.md, the STATE pending block and PDFs
Release tagging when the owner deploys

acceptance.text: npm run records rebuilds all views; a second run changes nothing
records:check fails for a duplicate ID, an unknown reference, approval without evidence, an edited history line and a stale view
Without pandoc the export prints PDF EXPORT BLOCKED, exits non-zero and keeps the previous PDFs
The cumulative PDF opens with pending approvals and current decisions, then REP-001 to REP-003
Every decision, status and approval quote from REP-001 to REP-003 is in the records
verify and CI run records:check and stay green
